_note: Production (NODE_ENV=production): push, ai, oauth, accounts and integrations — what the app's default build calls (sign-in is required and wearables are on: owner request 2026-11-12). pulse and backup are in the code and in config/app-dev.json; list one here to serve a build whose VITE_FEATURES turns it on (counts → pulse, cloudBackup → backup). ADMIN_KEY and AUTH_SECRET come from the environment; the server refuses to start without real values. Sign-in providers need APPLE_*/GOOGLE_*/FACEBOOK_* and email needs RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_FROM; a provider without its keys is reported as not configured and the app offers the others. Oura needs OURA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and Fitbit/Garmin/Whoop need TERRA_API_KEY/DEV_ID/SIGNING_SECRET; without them the app shows those rows as "Not set up yet".
